task: Place the MEDICINE_BOTTLE on MEDICAL_TABLE after removing the obstacle in front of the CAR.
plan_summary: The robot CAR needs to place the MEDICINE_BOTTLE on the MEDICAL_TABLE. However, there is an obstacle (FRONT_CRATE) in front of the robot that needs to be removed first. The plan is: 1) Navigate to the FRONT_CRATE, 2) Pick up the FRONT_CRATE, 3) Navigate to TEMP_ZONE to place it out of the way, 4) Place the FRONT_CRATE at TEMP_ZONE, 5) Navigate to the MEDICINE_BOTTLE, 6) Pick up the MEDICINE_BOTTLE, 7) Navigate to the MEDICAL_TABLE, 8) Place the MEDICINE_BOTTLE on the MEDICAL_TABLE.
assumptions: FRONT_CRATE is the obstacle in front of the CAR that needs to be removed
TEMP_ZONE is a suitable temporary location to place the FRONT_CRATE out of the way
The robot can pick up FRONT_CRATE since it is graspable
Navigation tolerance of 1.0 is sufficient to be within the interaction_distance of 2.0
